title: Pull request review policy
description: Which bots review a repository's pull requests, on which bases, when, and how often. A repository states it in .github/pr-review.json, and one carrying no file reads spec/pr-review.default.json. scripts/pr_review_policy.py is the reader, and tests/test_pr_review_policy.py holds its rules equal to this file. auto means only that the bot may start on its own.

command.description: The comment that requests a review: review is incremental, full review rereads the whole pull request.

trigger.description: How a review arrives. explicit: wait requests it. auto: the bot starts on its own, and wait fills a missed start only for a gated bot. off: never requested or waited on.

bases.description: The pull request base branches this bot reviews, each a full-match regex or @default for the repository's default branch.

when.description: Whether an explicit request waits for the head's checks to go green first.

rounds.description: once: one round per pull request. per-push: a round on each new head.

maxRounds.description: The most rounds requested on one pull request, or null for no cap. Past it, an attested local pass covers a new head.

gate.description: Whether the merge waits for this bot's review on the head. Defaults to true for copilot and false for the others.
